name: WorkshopLoadingPlanner
tagline: Load your workshop by bookable hours – not by guesswork.
description: A complete workshop capacity app for dealer service departments: bookable hours per technician and day, a colour-coded loading grid, a drag-and-drop day planner and a booking form that enforces express-lane, waiter, skill, absence and overbooking rules – in one Power Apps component for Canvas, Model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Bookable hours from attended hours × productivity
Technician × day loading grid with target and overbooking bands
Day planner with drag-to-reassign and rule checks
Express-lane and waiter rules, waiter slots per hour
Skill matching (EV, Diag, ADAS) and absences
Status flow with required fields and reasons
Demo mode with realistic fictional data
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field)
